description: Retire the stale agro cloud command and every surface it owns

userStories.title: Remove the cloud verb from the CLI
userStories.description: As an operator, I want agro cloud to stop dispatching so that the CLI stops advertising a command against a service this repository does not run.
acceptanceCriteria: Delete .agro/cli/src/commands/cloud.ts
Delete .agro/cli/src/__tests__/cloud.test.ts
Remove the runCloud import, the cloud help line, and the first === \"cloud\" dispatch from .agro/cli/src/cli.ts
Remove the cloud assertion from .agro/cli/src/__tests__/lifecycle.test.ts help surface test
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Remove cloud from the config schema and secrets
userStories.description: As an operator, I want cloud config keys gone from the schema so that agro.json carries no field for a retired command.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove CloudSettings, the cloud field, the cloud default, the cloud validation, and the cloud.apiUrl OH_CONFIG_FIELDS entry from .agro/cli/src/lib/oh-config.ts
Remove OH_CLOUD_PROVISION_KEY from SECRET_KEYS in .agro/cli/src/lib/secrets.ts
Remove the cloud section from agro.json
Remove OH_CLOUD_PROVISION_KEY from the fallback secret-key list in .agro/scripts/migrate-harness-yaml.sh
Update the cloud rows in .agro/cli/src/lib/__tests__/oh-config.test.ts and .agro/cli/src/__tests__/sandbox.test.ts to use a surviving config field
Typecheck passes and unit tests pass

userStories.title: Retire the compat-inventory rows in place
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the cloud compatibility rows marked retired rather than deleted so that the deferred phase-4 obligation stays on the record.
acceptanceCriteria: Mark the cloud rows in .agro/compat-inventory.json retired, referencing issue 1050, instead of deleting them
Keep the ~/.config/openharness/cloud.json path row so .agro/cli/src/lib/__tests__/compat-inventory.test.ts:98 still passes, updating its status only
Do not delete .agro/evals/probes/oh-config-surfaces.sh
compat-inventory tests pass

userStories.title: Update the lifecycle surface probe
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the tier-A verb probe to match the shipped verb set so that the suite stays green and honest.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove cloud from CLI_VERBS in .agro/evals/probes/oh-lifecycle-surface.sh
Remove the agro cloud row from docs/lifecycle-commands.md
The probe passes against the edited cli.ts

userStories.title: Align documentation and changelog
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the docs to stop describing a removed command so that no page teaches a surface that does not exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove the cloud table row and the OpenHarness Cloud section from .agro/cli/README.md
Remove the Cloud section and the cloud env-override entries from docs/configuration.md
Remove the OpenHarness Cloud provisioning block from .example.env
Reconcile the cloud references in docs/agro-compatibility.md with the retirement
Update the package description in .agro/cli/package.json if it names OpenHarness Cloud
Add a Removed entry to CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased citing issue 1050, at most 250 characters
No tracked file outside CHANGELOG history and archived task evidence references agro cloud or oh cloud
